title: Closeout Kit
user: A freelance developer or web studio finishing a client engagement who needs a clear, non-secret handoff of assets, ownership, access actions, and client acknowledgement.
smallest_useful_product: Local wizard for asset list, owners, links, transfer/revoke actions, support window, and client acknowledgement; exports a static HTML/PDF packet.
constraints: Never collect passwords, API keys, or private keys; include explicit confirmation of external transfer actions; retain only local encrypted packets.
